items.title: Show HN: A terminal-native idle factory game, written in Rust with ratatui
items.titleZh: Show HN：一款终端原生闲置工厂游戏，用 Rust 和ratatui 编写
items.summary:
Hey HN readers! I'm snipedbywifi ( https://gitlab.com/snipedbywifi ), and i've been working on terminactory. Please try it out if you'd like to play a cozy factory game while waiting for long agent tasks to finish! The game is a factory game (overused niche, i know xD), but runs in your terminal. Reason i built it? glad you asked: So basically, it started off with me wanting a terminal-native factory game. Me and the modern 5.5 claude models made a base for the game that I liked, and then i went ham adding features / fixing some minor flaws (like adding claude code hooks so you recieve "telegrams" [the agent's responses], so you can review progress directly in-game). (yes, I had heavy AI assistance, disclaimer!!!) Right now, the game has basic factory features you'd expect from a game like this (build stuff, delete stuff, measure how much you're earning, basic selection tools), along with a few more.. "unexpected" features. This includes a fake in-game browser that has a wiki, fake forums, some fun bits of lore, some more lore, a LOT more lore, and a research graph that shows how many items or how much RP (research points) you'd need to unlock something, and some more QOL features. If anyone actually has this issue / want of a terminal-based game that runs alongside your agents so you don't doomscroll, do you have any suggestions, or additional ideas I could add? It's hosted on GitLab, soo, that's one additional thing i'd like to mention Thanks for reading!! snipedbywifi (p.s. first HN post lol)
(p.s. p.s. there's a lot of hidden lore in the game, so.. lore-divers? you might like it?)

 Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50497132

 Points: 116

 # Comments: 24
items.summaryZh:
嘿 HN 读者！我是 snipedbywifi (https://gitlab.com/snipedbywifi)，我一直在研究 terminactory。如果您想在等待漫长的特工任务完成时玩舒适的工厂游戏，请尝试一下！该游戏是一款工厂游戏（过度使用的利基游戏，我知道 xD），但在您的终端中运行。我建造它的原因是什么？很高兴你问：所以基本上，一开始我想要一款终端本地工厂游戏。我和现代 5.5 克劳德模型为我喜欢的游戏奠定了基础，然后我开始添加功能/修复一些小缺陷（比如添加克劳德代码挂钩，这样你就可以收到“电报”[特工的回复]，这样你就可以直接在游戏中查看进度）。 （是的，我有大量的人工智能帮助，免责声明！！！）现在，该游戏具有您期望从此类游戏中获得的基本工厂功能（构建东西，删除东西，测量您的收入，基本选择工具），以及更多..“意外”功能。这包括一个假的游戏内浏览器，其中有一个维基、假的论坛、一些有趣的知识、更多的知识、更多的知识，以及一个显示你需要多少项目或多少 RP（研究点）来解锁某些东西的研究图表，以及更多的 QOL 功能。如果有人确实遇到这个问题/想要一款与您的代理一起运行的基于终端的游戏，这样您就不会出现末日滚动，您有什么建议或我可以添加的其他想法吗？它托管在 GitLab 上，所以，这是我想提的另一件事，感谢您的阅读！ snipedbywifi（注：第一个 HN 帖子，哈哈）
（注：游戏中有很多隐藏的传说，所以……传说潜水者？你可能会喜欢它？）
